import pandas as pd

# Create the dataframe from the provided table
data = {
    'jyutping': ['lei4', 'fan1', 'cin4', 'loeng2', 'gan1', 'daam3'],
    'character': ['厘', '分', '錢', '兩', '斤', '担 / 擔'],
    'portuguese': ['liz', 'condorim', 'maz', 'tael', 'cate', 'pico'],
    'relative value': ['1 / 1600', '1 / 1600', '1 / 160', '1 / 16', '1', '100'],
    'metric value': ['37.79931 mg', '377.9936375 mg', '3.779936375 g', '37.79936375 g', '604.78982 g', '60.478982 kg'],
    'imperial value': ['~0.2133 dr', '~0.2133 dr', '~2.1333dr', '~1.3333oz', '~1.3333lb', '~133.3333lb']
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Filter rows where character is in ['錢', '兩', '斤']
filtered_df = df[df['character'].isin(['錢', '兩', '斤'])]

# Check if all metric values in the filtered rows end with 'g' (grams)
all_in_g = filtered_df['metric value'].str.endswith('g').all()

# Assign the result to answer
answer = bool(all_in_g)
